mutations.because: N2/D221: writeOrReuse must compare bytes on EEXIST and only reuse when they match; dropping the sha256 compare makes it treat an EEXIST as a reuse of differing bytes, so two same-basename files of different bytes both map to one id.
command: two different files with one name take the plain name and the root suffix

mutations.because: PT-8-3/N2: probeCampaign must compare the REWRITTEN body (refs rewritten to ids) to the stored body; comparing the raw source body (still path refs) never matches a stored brief and falsely reports unchanged on a rerun.
command: a second importCampaign reports unchanged for a campaign whose refs took a suffixed name

mutations.because: PT-8-4/N3: an EEXIST at createCampaign is the plan's "slug reserved" signal and must be returned as refused (nothing else written); rethrowing lets the exclusive-create collision escape as an unhandled failure.
command: an EEXIST at createCampaign is listed as refused: slug reserved and nothing else is written

mutations.because: N4/D222: rewriteBriefRefs must throw when a path ref survives the rewrite; skipping the isAssetId assertion lets a path-shaped ref reach createBrief and into the stored brief.
command: the ref rewrite throws and createBrief is not called when a path survives

mutations.because: N6/D218: a uuid-shaped slug is refused before any write; skipping the check lets an import mint a campaign under a uuid instead of refusing it.
command: a uuid-shaped slug is refused and nothing is written

mutations.because: N10: preflight must parse the brief from the bytes it hashed and return THAT body; returning scanned.brief (a parse from the step's earlier, separate read) lets a body changed between the two reads be imported.
command: the body imported is the body whose bytes were hashed

mutations.because: D220/N10: briefs/<slug>/campaign.json must be hashed like the brief; skipping the hash check lets a name/type changed after the review be imported.
command: a campaign meta file changed after the hashes were taken refuses the campaign before any write
